mapper.sql: SELECT u.UserId, u.Username, u.Email, u.DisplayName, u.AvatarUrl, u.Bio, u.Role, u.Status, u.CreatedAt, u.LastLoginAt, u.RowVer AS RowVersion, a.UserId AS Author_AuthorId, a.PenName AS Author_PenName, a.Bio AS Author_Bio, a.IsVerified AS Author_IsVerified, a.FollowerCount AS Author_FollowerCount FROM dbo.[User] u LEFT JOIN dbo.Author a ON a.UserId = u.UserId
mapper.select: SELECT PasswordHash FROM dbo.[User] WHERE UserId = #{userId}
